2609.24186.title: LIMIT: Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL
2609.24186.paper_summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable progress on Text-to-SQL through reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning, yet existing approaches predominantly rely on massive instruction corpora under the assumption that scale drives performance. We challenge this paradigm by investigating a fundamental question: what is the minimal data requirement for effective Text-to-SQL instruction tuning? We propose LIMIT(Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL), a data-centric framework that demonstrates strong database reasoning can emerge from an extremely compact training set when examples are strategically selected. LIMIT operates through four stages: difficulty-aware filtering that identifies samples within the model's learning frontier, chain-of-thought synthesis with consistency-based selection, multi-dimensional quality scoring via LLM-as-judge, and genetic algorithm optimization that jointly maximizes schema coverage and sample quality. On the BIRD and Spider benchmark, LIMIT selects only 796 and 863 samples while achieving 100% table coverage, enabling Qwen3-8B to reach 69.1% and 88.9% execution accuracy.This result surpasses methods trained on 20 times more data and establishes a new state-of-the-art among open-source approaches. Our findings suggest that careful data curation, rather than scale, is the key to efficient Text-to-SQL learning.
2609.24186.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在透過增強推理的微調上，已在文本到 SQL 的領域取得了顯著進展，然而現有的方法主要依賴於大量的指令語料庫，假設規模推動性能。我們挑戰這一範式，探討一個基本問題：有效的文本到 SQL 指令調整的最小數據需求是什麼？我們提出了 LIMIT（Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL），這是一個以數據為中心的框架，顯示出當範例被策略性選擇時，強大的數據庫推理可以從極其緊湊的訓練集中產生。LIMIT 通過四個階段運作：難度感知過濾，識別模型學習邊界內的樣本；基於一致性的思維鏈合成；通過 LLM-as-judge 的多維質量評分；以及基因算法優化，聯合最大化模式覆蓋和樣本質量。在 BIRD 和 Spider 基準上，LIMIT 僅選擇了 796 和 863 個樣本，同時實現了 100% 的表格覆蓋，使 Qwen3-8B 達到 69.1% 和 88.9% 的執行準確率。這一結果超越了在 20 倍更多數據上訓練的方法，並在開源方法中建立了新的最先進水平。我們的發現表明，謹慎的數據策劃，而非規模，是高效文本到 SQL 學習的關鍵。
